text:
maya singh: Quick note 1 I'm updating the 'hello-walkthrough' quickstart to use SDK v8 auth helpers and a tiny container hint. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3812. Ran locally and got a 401.

noah ellis: Probably the env var rename (REDWOOD_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY). Which files still reference the old name?

maya singh: README bash block and Dockerfile ARG. Also the JS snippet still calls oldClient().

carla mendez: Swap to createClientFromEnv(), add a minimal bash export (no quotes), and include both Node and Python tiny snippets. Keep everything short.

maya singh: Plan: replace vars, update helper call, restore Docker ARG example, and add a short secrets callout linking to /docs/security/secrets.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #3812  lint, linkcheck.

docs-bot: linkcheck: warning: docs/quickstart/hello-walkthrough.md line 22 -> https://old-auth.example (redirect).

maya singh: I'll update to /docs/auth and add a one-liner pointer to /enterprise/kms for customers using instance roles.

noah ellis: Suggested snippets: Node:
```js
import { createClientFromEnv } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = createClientFromEnv();
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-v1', prompt: 'hi' });
console.log(r.text);
```
Python:
```py
from redwood_inference import create_client_from_env
client = create_client_from_env()
print(client.generate(model='redwood-v1', prompt='hi').text)
```

carla mendez: Add admonition: "Do not bake API keys into images; prefer runtime injection or BuildKit secrets." Link to /docs/security/secrets.

maya singh: Made the changes, pushed, and added a TODO to add a CI smoke test that builds quickstarts (no real keys). Assigning @noah and @carla as reviewers.

docs-bot: All checks passed for PR #3812. Ready for review.

carla mendez: LGTM, merging. Small but important for onboarding.

maya singh: Verified staging render; snippets are correct and Docker note present. Closing thread.
